name: Git status
author: Brett
description: Where everything stands in git, as grids with expandable rows: what needs pushing (local commits on the VPS worktrees, pushed branches with no PR), what needs pulling (behind main), what is in CI (running, queued, failed, with the failing lines), what is ready to merge, what is held and why (UI Review, conflicts, a draft, a hold, a dependency PR), what merged today, which app runs which commit, and what is stale. Every row leads with the PR number and a plain-English line of what it does, and expands to its checks, commits, files and diffs, build and steps, UI Review item, what blocks it and what clears it, with Merge, Hold, Update from main, Re-run CI, Fix, Close and Land/Kill. Push batches with live badges and merge order. Zero tokens: git, GitHub and files only.

items.title: Whole board
items.description: Every row in every section (needs push, needs pull, in CI, ready, held, merged today, deployed, stale), the batches and the sources' health. since=<stamp> answers {same:true} while nothing changed.

items.title: Sections and counts
items.description: Each Git status section with how many rows it has right now.

items.title: List a section
items.description: One section's rows in short form: key, plain-English line, branch, agent, status, CI, ahead/behind, age, cost and what blocks it. section = push | pull | ci | ready | held | merged | deployed | stale.

items.title: PR or branch detail
items.description: One row in full: every check with its failing lines, commits, linked build and steps, UI Review items, what blocks it and what clears that.

items.title: Changed files
items.description: A PR's changed files with their diffs.

items.title: Push batches
items.description: Every push batch with live badges and its PRs in merge order.

items.title: Merge a PR
items.description: Merges one PR through the push banner: only when it is up to date with main, CI passed on its pinned head and nothing holds it.

key.description: the row key: <owner>/<name>#<n> for a PR, <owner>/<name>:<branch> for a pushed branch

items.title: Hold or release a PR
items.description: Puts a PR on hold (auto-merge skips it and Merge refuses it) or releases it. on = true / false (default: toggle).

items.title: Update from main
items.description: Pulls main into a PR or pushed branch that is behind (the push banner's Pull main in).

key.description: the row key: <owner>/<name>#<n> for a PR, <owner>/<name>:<branch> for a pushed branch

items.title: Re-run CI
items.description: Re-runs the failed CI jobs on a PR's head commit.

key.description: the row key: <owner>/<name>#<n> for a PR, <owner>/<name>:<branch> for a pushed branch

items.title: Fix with an agent
items.description: Sends an ops-fix job (failing lines included) to the agent who owns it (Merge Max). Spends that agent's budget.

key.description: the row key: <owner>/<name>#<n> for a PR, <owner>/<name>:<branch> for a pushed branch

items.title: Land a stale branch
items.description: Sends a land-build job for the branch to Landin' Lenny.

key.description: the row key: <owner>/<name>#<n> for a PR, <owner>/<name>:<branch> for a pushed branch

items.title: Close a PR
items.description: Closes an open PR without merging it (its branch stays).

key.description: the row key: <owner>/<name>#<n> for a PR, <owner>/<name>:<branch> for a pushed branch

items.title: Kill a stale branch
items.description: Deletes a pushed GitHub branch that has no open PR.

key.description: the row key: <owner>/<name>#<n> for a PR, <owner>/<name>:<branch> for a pushed branch

items.title: New batch
items.description: Makes a push batch from PR keys (merge order = the order given).

items.title: Add to batch
items.description: Puts a PR in a batch (taking it out of any other one).

items.title: Take out of batch
items.description: Takes a PR out of a batch.

items.title: Set merge order
items.description: Sets the merge order of a batch (the same PR keys, new order).

items.title: Merge next in batch
items.description: One step of a batch in its merge order: merges the first ready PR (pulling main in first when it is behind) or says what the first one waits for.

items.title: Remove a batch
items.description: Deletes a batch (its PRs stay open).
